name: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst Edit Image
description: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst Edit Image is available in the Business API catalog.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate.
prompt.title: Prompt

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Ignored when 'size' is set.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

output_format.description: Image file format of the output.
output_format.title: Output Format

background.description: Background of the output. 'transparent' needs a png or webp output_format.
background.title: Background

size.description: Explicit output size as 'WxH' (e.g. '1024x1024'), or 'auto' to let the provider choose. Overrides aspect_ratio and resolution.
size.title: Size

image_urls.description: URLs of the source images to edit.
image_urls.title: Image Urls

mask_image_url.description: Mask URL marking the region to edit (transparent areas are edited). Must be a PNG with an alpha channel; the provider rejects masks without one.
mask_image_url.title: Mask Image Url
